purpose: Teach: 栄養素/詰将棋/偶像/太陽系/オアシス/ボーイング/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが栄養素のバランスを大事にしてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father really does care about having balanced nutrition in everything.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. A small smile in the voice — noticing something true about her husband. Gentle pacing, no urgency. She's thinking out loud to her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと詰将棋やってみたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to try playing tsume-shogi with Grandpa.
lines.style: Direct, bright request. No hesitation. The enthusiasm of a child who's thought about this and decided. Quick, genuine — not performing, just asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがお寺の偶像をご覧になったのよ
lines.en: Sho — your grandmother saw some statues at the temple, did you know?
lines.style: Conversational, gently redirecting. A small lift of interest in her voice — sharing something she noticed. Unhurried, warm. Not quite answering his question, but inviting him to follow her thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと太陽系の本読みたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to read a book about the solar system with Dad.
lines.style: Quieter than before, but still clear intention. A small pause before 'solar system' — he's thinking of it, picturing it. Soft and sincere. Not loud, just real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママのお庭はぼくらのオアシスね
lines.en: Sho — the garden that Mama tends to, it's really our little oasis, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, almost confiding tone. A slight breath before speaking, like she's sharing something tender. Slow, warm pace. The voice of someone looking at something she loves and wanting him to see it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとボーイング社の旅客機を見に行きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go see the airplanes — the Boeing ones — with Dad.
lines.style: Smaller, quieter voice than the earlier requests. A little more vulnerable. Still eager, but there's wonder underneath it. He's picturing the moment, not just stating the want.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんから「火薬には絶対触らないように」って
lines.en: Sho — your father told you to never, ever touch gunpowder, didn't he?
lines.style: Serious, protective undertone. A firmer edge to the voice than before — this isn't reflection, it's emphasis. Still warm, but unmistakably a mother's instruction wrapped in a question. Clear pace, no trailing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが油田で働く海外駐在員のお話してくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me about the people who work overseas at the oil fields.
lines.style: Soft, reminiscent. He's sharing something he heard and is still thinking about. A small wonder in his voice — the world is big and far away. Gentle, unhurried, like he's holding onto the story.
